column1: # Runtime voice: lines that only exist in game, because they hold real values. Piper speaks them, no audio is built.
# Every .tsv in this folder is read, in name order. Add a row, or a file of your own, and restart KSP.
# UTF-8, tab separated, # starts a comment line. The columns are found by name: id kind when spanish english.
# This header explains them all. The other files in this folder use the same format.
# id       a-z 0-9 _, starts with rt_, unique over all files
# kind     report (now and then), dock (after a docking approach call), land (once per descent, low and falling),
#          science, science_pts (after a science reaction), contract_funds, contract_done, contract_failed
#          warp: Mission Control in time warp on rails, now and then in place of the usual exchange (warp.tsv)
#          reply: a kerbal answers a Mission Control line right after it, sometimes. to=rt_fuel_low in the when
#          column: the MC lines it answers (a prefix with *: to=rt_orbit*). Without to=: any report or warp line.
#          self is the kerbal who answers (replies.tsv). Without to= it can also follow a sunrise line, or a
#          recorded calm chatter scene that ends with a Mission Control statement.
#          sunrise: Mission Control at a sunrise in orbit, now and then (sunrise_biome.tsv)
#          eva: Mission Control to a kerbal on EVA, also the report on EVA. flag: after a flag is planted (eva_flag.tsv)
#          chat: an intercom chat between two kerbals. Id rt_chat_<name>_<seq>, one row per line, seq 1, 2, 3.
#          Kerbal A speaks the odd lines, kerbal B the even ones. Only line 1 has a when. A chat stays in one file.
#          A chat with on_eva=1 is for two EVA kerbals (eva_chats.tsv), one with apart=1 for two kerbals of different
#          vessels nearby (radio_chats.tsv). Both play over the radio, the others only in one cabin.
#          An event chat has on= in the when (on=flag on=surfacesample ...): it only plays on that event and may have
#          one line, for a kerbal alone (event_chats.tsv).
# when     empty or any: always. A situation (orbit flight suborbital landed escape) and/or checks like fuel<25
#          or node_min>=2. Several situations: one must match. Every check must hold.
#          In a chat also the job of a kerbal: a=pilot (kerbal A, who starts) and/or b=scientist (kerbal B).
#          Jobs: pilot engineer scientist tourist. The chat only plays when the two kerbals have those jobs, in
#          either order: if only B has the job of a, B starts. A kerbal with a job from a mod fits no job check.
#          Personas work the same way: badass brave nervous dim veteran (a=dim b=veteran). Several for one kerbal
#          (a=pilot a=brave): all must hold.
#          on=: the event of an event chat, or the experiment of a science line: flag deploy science (any
#          experiment) evareport surfacesample roc crewreport mysterygoo and the other stock experiment ids.
#          Or an event of another mod: on=yourmod.event (docs/API.md). Then also kind event (a Mission Control
#          line about it), kind meta (cooldown= priority= who=, no text) and your own slots {x_name}.
# spanish  normal Spanish. A number slot becomes Spanish words, reversed like every other word (loñapsE).
#          A name slot is spoken as the name. Write the number before a masculine noun: "un" for 1 is made.
# english  the subtitle. A number slot shows digits, a name slot the name.
# Versions: spanish and english may hold several versions split by |, in the same order. One is picked per play,
#   from the versions whose slots all have a value. Each spanish version uses the same slots as its english one.
#   Put lines with the same when in one row as versions. Give a line with another when its own row.
# Number slots: alt_km pe_km ap_km speed fuel day sci funds inc_deg period_min t_ap_min t_pe_min ec mono parts
#   crew node_dv node_min funds_total sci_total rep contracts dist_m close_ms height_m vspeed_ms
#   at_home flight_no missions stars visits landings (crew history, see below)
#   in_warp (1 in time warp, for checks only) node_h (hours to the burn) soi_h (hours until the orbit leaves this body)
#   sci_left sci_first con_sci con_rep (science and contract lines, see science_contracts.tsv)
#   sunrises (sunrises in orbit this flight)
#   jet ship_m eva_mins (on EVA: jetpack percent, meters to the ship, minutes outside, see eva_flag.tsv)
#   on_eva (1 on EVA, for checks only: a chat with on_eva=1 plays on the suit radio) pair_m (meters between two
#   kerbals in an EVA chat, see eva_chats.tsv)
#   link (1 with a link to Mission Control, 0 without one or in a blackout, for checks only)
#   apart a_eva b_eva (radio chats between two vessels: apart is 1, a_eva is 1 when kerbal A is on EVA, b_eva the
#   same for kerbal B, for checks only, see radio_chats.tsv)
#   (km, min, h, deg, ms, sci, sci_left and con_sci get one decimal below 10, the rest whole numbers)
# Name slots: vessel body here exp target, next (the body after soi_h), biome (under the vessel), flag (a flag line), device (a deployed part with its article),
#   my_ship and their_ship (in a chat between two vessels: the ship of the speaker and of the one spoken to), kerbal in a report, and in a chat self (the speaker) and other (the one
#   spoken to). The same list is in src/Slots.cs.
# Crew history: in a report {kerbal} is the kerbal Mission Control talks to, and these numbers are that kerbal's.
#   In a chat they are the numbers of kerbal A (who starts). flight_no (this flight, 1 is the first), missions
#   (flights that ended with a recovery), visits and landings (earlier flights that reached or landed on this body),
#   stars (experience level). at_home is 1 at Kerbin, else 0. A template that uses them only plays with crew aboard.
# Avoid a plural noun after a value that can be 1: use a check like node_min>=2.

column1: rt_orbit
column4: Órbita estable. Periapsis {pe_km} kilómetros, apoapsis {ap_km} kilómetros. | Os vemos a {alt_km} kilómetros sobre {body}. | Seguimos vuestra órbita. Vais a {speed} metros por segundo. Nada mal. | Órbita confirmada. Periapsis a {pe_km} kilómetros.
column5: Stable orbit. Periapsis {pe_km} km, apoapsis {ap_km} km. | We see you {alt_km} km above {body}. | Tracking your orbit. You're doing {speed} m/s. Not bad. | Orbit confirmed. Periapsis at {pe_km} km.

column1: rt_orbit_inc
column4: Inclinación de {inc_deg} grados. Los de navegación están contentos. | Vuestra órbita tiene {inc_deg} grados de inclinación. Bonita vista de los polos. | Inclinación {inc_deg} grados. Anotado en el cuaderno de vuelo.
column5: Inclination {inc_deg} degrees. Navigation is happy. | Your orbit has {inc_deg} degrees of inclination. Nice view of the poles. | Inclination {inc_deg} degrees. It's in the flight log.

column1: rt_orbit_eq
column4: Órbita casi ecuatorial. Menos de un grado de inclinación. | Inclinación casi cero. Seguís el ecuador como un tren. | Órbita ecuatorial. Los de navegación están orgullosos.
column5: Almost equatorial orbit. Less than one degree of inclination. | Inclination almost zero. You follow the equator like a train. | Equatorial orbit. Navigation is proud.

column1: rt_orbit_period
column4: Una vuelta completa os lleva {period_min} minutos. | Periodo orbital, {period_min} minutos. Da tiempo para un café. | Dais una vuelta cada {period_min} minutos.
column5: One full orbit takes you {period_min} minutes. | Orbital period, {period_min} minutes. Time for a coffee. | You go around once every {period_min} minutes.

column1: rt_orbit_tap
column4: Apoapsis en {t_ap_min} minutos. | Llegáis a la apoapsis en {t_ap_min} minutos. | Faltan {t_ap_min} minutos para la apoapsis. Os avisamos.
column5: Apoapsis in {t_ap_min} minutes. | You reach apoapsis in {t_ap_min} minutes. | {t_ap_min} minutes to apoapsis. We'll let you know.

column1: rt_orbit_tpe
column4: Periapsis en {t_pe_min} minutos. Os avisamos. | Faltan {t_pe_min} minutos para la periapsis. | Periapsis dentro de {t_pe_min} minutos. El punto más bajo de la vuelta.
column5: Periapsis in {t_pe_min} minutes. We'll let you know. | {t_pe_min} minutes to periapsis. | Periapsis in {t_pe_min} minutes. The lowest point of the orbit.

column1: rt_flight
column4: Altitud {alt_km} kilómetros, velocidad {speed} metros por segundo. Todo bien. | Os seguimos a {alt_km} kilómetros de altura. Seguid así. | Velocidad {speed} metros por segundo. Pantallas en verde.
column5: Altitude {alt_km} km, speed {speed} m/s. All good. | We have you at {alt_km} km. Keep it up. | Speed {speed} m/s. Screens are green.

column1: rt_sub_ap
column4: Apoapsis a {ap_km} kilómetros. Todavía no es una órbita. | Trayectoria suborbital. Apoapsis a {ap_km} kilómetros. Lo que sube, baja. | Apoapsis a {ap_km} kilómetros. Os falta un poco para la órbita.
column5: Apoapsis at {ap_km} km. Not an orbit yet. | Suborbital path. Apoapsis at {ap_km} km. What goes up comes down. | Apoapsis at {ap_km} km. A bit short of orbit.

column1: rt_sub_tap
column4: Llegáis a la apoapsis en {t_ap_min} minutos. | Apoapsis en {t_ap_min} minutos. Disfrutad de la ingravidez. | Faltan {t_ap_min} minutos para el punto más alto.
column5: You reach apoapsis in {t_ap_min} minutes. | Apoapsis in {t_ap_min} minutes. Enjoy the zero g. | {t_ap_min} minutes to the highest point.

column1: rt_landed
column4: Os tenemos en la superficie de {body}. Buen sitio. | Contacto con {body} confirmado. Bienvenidos. | Estáis en {body}. Recordad dónde habéis aparcado.
column5: We have you on the surface of {body}. Nice spot. | Contact with {body} confirmed. Welcome. | You're on {body}. Remember where you parked.

column1: rt_escape
column4: Vais camino de salir de {body}. Velocidad {speed} metros por segundo. | Trayectoria de escape. {body} se queda atrás. | Trayectoria de escape confirmada. Os vais a {speed} metros por segundo.
column5: You're on your way out of {body}. Speed {speed} m/s. | Escape trajectory. {body} is falling behind. | Escape trajectory confirmed. You're leaving at {speed} m/s.

column1: rt_fuel
column4: Según nuestras pantallas os queda el {fuel} por ciento de combustible. | Combustible al {fuel} por ciento. Vamos bien. | Os queda el {fuel} por ciento del combustible de esta etapa.
column5: Our screens say you have {fuel} percent fuel left. | Fuel at {fuel} percent. We're good. | You have {fuel} percent of this stage's fuel left.

column1: rt_fuel_low
column4: Ojo con el combustible. Solo queda el {fuel} por ciento. | Combustible al {fuel} por ciento. Pensad bien la próxima maniobra. | Combustible en reserva. El {fuel} por ciento y bajando.
column5: Watch the fuel. Only {fuel} percent left. | Fuel at {fuel} percent. Think hard about the next burn. | Fuel on reserve. {fuel} percent and dropping.

column1: rt_ec_low
column4: Batería al {ec} por ciento. Apagad algo, por favor. | Solo queda el {ec} por ciento de batería. Ahorrad energía. | Energía baja. Batería al {ec} por ciento. Paneles al sol, por favor.
column5: Battery at {ec} percent. Turn something off, please. | Only {ec} percent battery left. Save power. | Low power. Battery at {ec} percent. Panels to the sun, please.

column1: rt_ec_ok
column4: Batería al {ec} por ciento. Energía de sobra. | La batería está al {ec} por ciento. Todo en verde. | Batería al {ec} por ciento. Podéis encender la cafetera.
column5: Battery at {ec} percent. Plenty of power. | Battery is at {ec} percent. All green. | Battery at {ec} percent. You can turn the coffee maker on.

column1: rt_mono
column4: Queda el {mono} por ciento de monopropelente. Con calma con los propulsores. | Monopropelente al {mono} por ciento. Guardadlo para el atraque. | Solo queda el {mono} por ciento de monopropelente. Toques cortos.
column5: {mono} percent monoprop left. Easy on the RCS. | Monoprop at {mono} percent. Save it for docking. | Only {mono} percent monoprop left. Short taps.

column1: rt_parts
column4: La nave tiene {parts} piezas. Esperamos que sigan todas ahí. | Contamos {parts} piezas en la nave. Que no se suelte ninguna. | {parts} piezas. Los ingenieros dicen que todas son importantes.
column5: The ship has {parts} parts. We hope they're all still there. | We count {parts} parts on the ship. Don't let any come loose. | {parts} parts. Engineering says they're all important.

column1: rt_crew
column4: Contamos {crew} kerbals a bordo. Que nadie se esconda. | {crew} kerbals a bordo. Turnaos para el asiento de la ventana. | Tripulación de {crew}. Repartid bien la comida.
column5: We count {crew} kerbals aboard. No hiding. | {crew} kerbals aboard. Take turns for the window seat. | Crew of {crew}. Share the food fairly.

column1: rt_day
column4: Día {day} de la misión. Aquí abajo todo en orden. | Llevamos {day} días de misión. Seguimos aquí. | Día {day}. Seguimos con vosotros.
column5: Mission day {day}. All fine down here. | That's {day} days into the mission. We're still here. | Day {day}. We're still with you.

column1: rt_day_first
column4: Primer día de la misión. Ya sois famosos. | Primer día. Todo va según el plan, más o menos. | Día uno de la misión. Que sea el primero de muchos.
column5: First day of the mission. You're famous already. | Day one. Everything's going to plan, more or less. | Mission day one. May it be the first of many.

column1: rt_vessel
column4: {vessel}, aquí Control. Os seguimos en pantalla. | {vessel}, os oímos alto y claro. | {vessel}, aquí Control. Solo comprobamos que seguís ahí.
column5: {vessel}, Control here. We have you on screen. | {vessel}, we hear you loud and clear. | {vessel}, Control here. Just checking you're still there.

column1: rt_node
column4: Próxima maniobra en {node_min} minutos. Son {node_dv} metros por segundo. | Maniobra en {node_min} minutos, {node_dv} metros por segundo. Preparad la nave. | Faltan {node_min} minutos para la maniobra. Os tocan {node_dv} metros por segundo.
column5: Next burn in {node_min} minutes. That's {node_dv} m/s. | Burn in {node_min} minutes, {node_dv} m/s. Get the ship ready. | {node_min} minutes to the burn. {node_dv} m/s for you.

column1: rt_node_dv
column4: La maniobra pide {node_dv} metros por segundo. Que no se os pase. | Delta uve de la maniobra, {node_dv} metros por segundo. | {node_dv} metros por segundo en la próxima maniobra. Apuntad bien.
column5: The burn needs {node_dv} m/s. Don't miss it. | Burn delta-v, {node_dv} m/s. | {node_dv} m/s on the next burn. Aim well.

column1: rt_funds
column4: Contabilidad informa: tenemos {funds_total} fondos. | Hay {funds_total} fondos en la caja. De momento. | Contabilidad dice {funds_total} fondos. No lo gastéis todo en cohetes.
column5: Accounting reports: we have {funds_total} funds. | There are {funds_total} funds in the bank. For now. | Accounting says {funds_total} funds. Don't spend it all on rockets.

column1: rt_funds_low
column4: Quedan {funds_total} fondos. Volved con algo de valor. | Solo {funds_total} fondos en la caja. No rompáis nada caro. | Vamos justos, {funds_total} fondos. Cada pieza cuenta.
column5: {funds_total} funds left. Bring back something valuable. | Only {funds_total} funds in the bank. Don't break anything expensive. | Money is tight, {funds_total} funds. Every part counts.

column1: rt_sci_total
column4: El laboratorio tiene {sci_total} puntos de ciencia. Quieren más. | {sci_total} puntos de ciencia en casa. Los científicos piden más. | Ciencia acumulada, {sci_total} puntos. Seguid midiendo cosas.
column5: The lab has {sci_total} science points. They want more. | {sci_total} science points at home. The scientists want more. | Science banked, {sci_total} points. Keep measuring things.

column1: rt_rep
column4: Nuestra reputación está en {rep}. El público os quiere. | Reputación {rep}. Salís en las noticias. | Con {rep} de reputación, hasta nos piden autógrafos.
column5: Our reputation is at {rep}. The public loves you. | Reputation {rep}. You're on the news. | With {rep} reputation, they even ask us for autographs.

column1: rt_rep_low
column4: Reputación en {rep}. El público tiene dudas. | La reputación está en {rep}. Un buen vuelo lo arregla.
column5: Reputation at {rep}. The public has doubts. | Reputation is at {rep}. A good flight will fix it.

column1: rt_contracts
column4: Hay {contracts} contratos abiertos. Nadie dijo que fuera fácil. | {contracts} contratos esperan. Sin prisa, pero sin pausa. | La lista de contratos tiene {contracts} entradas. Elegid bien.
column5: There are {contracts} open contracts. Nobody said it would be easy. | {contracts} contracts waiting. No rush, but don't stop. | The contract list has {contracts} entries. Choose well.

column1: rt_orbit_high
column4: Apoapsis a {ap_km} kilómetros. Desde ahí arriba se ve todo. | {ap_km} kilómetros de apoapsis. Muy lejos de casa.
column5: Apoapsis at {ap_km} km. You can see everything from up there. | {ap_km} km apoapsis. A long way from home.

column1: rt_orbit_fast
column4: Vais a {speed} metros por segundo. Nada de abrir ventanas. | {speed} metros por segundo en órbita. Que nadie saque la mano.
column5: You're doing {speed} m/s. No opening windows. | {speed} m/s in orbit. Keep your hands inside.

column1: rt_orbit_slow
column4: Solo {speed} metros por segundo. Una órbita tranquila. | Órbita lenta, {speed} metros por segundo. Sin prisas.
column5: Only {speed} m/s. A lazy orbit. | Slow orbit, {speed} m/s. No rush.

column1: rt_orbit_polar
column4: Órbita polar. Pasáis por encima de los dos polos. | Inclinación {inc_deg} grados. Buena órbita para hacer mapas.
column5: Polar orbit. You fly over both poles. | Inclination {inc_deg} degrees. A good orbit for mapping.

column1: rt_orbit_retro
column4: Órbita retrógrada. Vais al revés que todo el mundo. | Inclinación {inc_deg} grados. Dais vueltas al revés. Original.
column5: Retrograde orbit. You're going the other way from everyone. | Inclination {inc_deg} degrees. You're orbiting backwards. Original.

column1: rt_orbit_long
column4: Una vuelta os lleva {period_min} minutos. Traed libros.
column5: One orbit takes you {period_min} minutes. Bring books.

column1: rt_flight_high
column4: {alt_km} kilómetros de altura. El aire se queda abajo. | A {alt_km} kilómetros. Seguid subiendo con calma.
column5: {alt_km} km up. The air stays below. | At {alt_km} km. Keep climbing, nice and easy.

column1: rt_flight_low
column4: Muy bajos, a {alt_km} kilómetros. Ojo con las montañas. | Vuelo bajo. Disfrutad del paisaje, pero sin tocarlo.
column5: Very low, {alt_km} km. Watch the mountains. | Flying low. Enjoy the scenery, but don't touch it.

column1: rt_escape_home
column4: Salís de la esfera de {body}. Llamad a casa de vez en cuando. | Adiós a {body} por un tiempo. Buen viaje.
column5: You're leaving {body}'s sphere. Call home now and then. | Goodbye to {body} for a while. Have a good trip.

column1: rt_landed_home
column4: En tierra en {body}. Todo tranquilo. | Seguís en {body}. Por lo menos aquí hay aire.
column5: On the ground at {body}. All quiet. | Still on {body}. At least there's air here.

column1: rt_landed_far
column4: Estáis muy lejos de casa, en {body}. Disfrutad de la vista. | Superficie de {body}. Recordad: nada de lamer las rocas.
column5: You're a long way from home, on {body}. Enjoy the view. | Surface of {body}. Remember: no licking rocks.

column1: rt_fuel_full
column4: Depósitos casi llenos, al {fuel} por ciento. El viaje acaba de empezar.
column5: Tanks almost full, {fuel} percent. The trip has just begun.

column1: rt_fuel_empty
column4: Combustible casi agotado. Lo demás lo hace la gravedad. | Depósitos vacíos, o casi. Pensad antes de encender nada.
column5: Fuel almost gone. Gravity does the rest. | Tanks empty, or nearly. Think before you light anything.

column1: rt_mono_ok
column4: Monopropelente al {mono} por ciento. Podéis jugar con los propulsores.
column5: Monoprop at {mono} percent. You can play with the RCS.

column1: rt_ec_mid
column4: Batería al {ec} por ciento. Ni bien ni mal. | Energía al {ec} por ciento. Vigilad los paneles.
column5: Battery at {ec} percent. Not good, not bad. | Power at {ec} percent. Keep an eye on the panels.

column1: rt_day_long
column4: Día {day}. Ya sois casi vecinos de allí arriba. | Llevamos {day} días. Aquí abajo os echamos de menos.
column5: Day {day}. You're almost locals up there. | {day} days now. We miss you down here.

column1: rt_parts_small
column4: Una nave de solo {parts} piezas. Menos cosas que se rompan.
column5: A ship of only {parts} parts. Fewer things to break.

column1: rt_crew_solo
column4: Un solo kerbal a bordo. Si te aburres, habla con las plantas.
column5: Just one kerbal aboard. If you get bored, talk to the plants.

column1: rt_node_soon
column4: Maniobra en menos de dos minutos. Atentos. | La maniobra está al caer. {node_dv} metros por segundo.
column5: Burn in less than two minutes. Stand by. | The burn is coming up. {node_dv} m/s.
